The Perfect 14 Days in Vietnam 🇻🇳 | A Seamless Journey from North to South for Indian Travelers

Looking for the ultimate Vietnam itinerary? 🇻🇳✨

This 14 Days Vietnam Premium Tour takes you on a seamless journey from the misty mountains of Sapa in the north to the tropical paradise of Phu Quoc in the south. Designed especially for Indian travelers, this itinerary combines breathtaking landscapes, rich cultural heritage, iconic landmarks, and unforgettable local experiences.

From the Roof of Indochina at Fansipan and the emerald waters of Ha Long Bay to the Golden Bridge, the Mekong Delta, and Phu Quoc's crystal-clear beaches, this tour showcases the very best of Vietnam in comfort and style.

🌏 14-Day Vietnam Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi Arrival with Guide
Day 2: Hanoi → Sapa → Cat Cat Village (Private Car) (B)
Day 3: Fansipan Peak Excursion → Return to Hanoi (Private Car) (B)
Day 4: Ha Long Bay Day Cruise with Ambassador Cruise (Private Transfer) (B, L)
Day 5: Hanoi → Da Nang Flight with Guide Pickup (B)
Day 6: Cam Thanh Coconut Jungle & Hoi An Ancient Town with Lantern Boat Experience (Private Tour) (B)
Day 7: Ba Na Hills & Golden Bridge Tour (Private Tour) (B, L)
Day 8: Da Nang → Ho Chi Minh City Flight with Guide Pickup (B)
Day 9: Mekong Delta Day Trip (Private Tour) (B)
Day 10: Cu Chi Tunnels Tour (Private Tour) (B)
Day 11: Ho Chi Minh City → Phu Quoc Flight (No Guide) (B)
Day 12: Phu Quoc 4-Island Tour & Cable Car Experience (Private Tour) (B)
Day 13: VinWonders & Vinpearl Safari Experience (Private Tour) (B)
Day 14: Phu Quoc Departure (B)

✨ Tour Highlights

✔ Explore Vietnam from North to South in one unforgettable journey
✔ Visit Hanoi, Sapa, Ha Long Bay, Da Nang, Hoi An, Ho Chi Minh City & Phu Quoc
✔ Ride the famous Fansipan Cable Car to the highest peak in Indochina
✔ Cruise through the stunning limestone landscapes of Ha Long Bay aboard Ambassador Cruise
✔ Experience Hoi An's lantern-filled evenings and Coconut Jungle adventure
✔ Walk on the world-famous Golden Bridge at Ba Na Hills
✔ Discover the fascinating history of the Cu Chi Tunnels
✔ Explore the waterways and local life of the Mekong Delta
✔ Relax in the tropical paradise of Phu Quoc Island
✔ Enjoy VinWonders, Vinpearl Safari, and the spectacular 4-Island Cable Car Tour
✔ Premium hotels, private transfers, and Indian-friendly services throughout the trip

Whether you're a family, couple, honeymooner, or first-time visitor, this itinerary offers the perfect mix of adventure, culture, nature, and relaxation.
